display.purpose: Landing hero headline, vote result announcement. One per view maximum.

headline.purpose: Page titles, section breaks, modal headers.

title.purpose: Card headings, form step labels, list section dividers.

body.purpose: Vote descriptions, candidate bios, helper text. Max 68ch line length.

label.purpose: Status chips, nav items, table headers, metadata. Sentence case.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover-state lift on interactive rows and cards. Never at rest.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Solid Assembly Blue. Used for: submit ballot, create vote, publish, confirm destructive action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: oklch(0.49 0.21 255); color: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.49 0.21 255 / 0.82); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.49 0.21 255); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.49 0.21 255 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Primary Button (Large)
components.description: Voter-facing CTA. 44px tall for in-room phone tap targets.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-lg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; background: oklch(0.49 0.21 255); color: #ffffff; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary-lg:hover { background: oklch(0.49 0.21 255 / 0.82); } .ds-btn-primary-lg:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.49 0.21 255 / 0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary actions. Nav items, row actions (View →), cancel in dialogs.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.55 0.02 255); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0.008 255); color: oklch(0.13 0.025 255); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.49 0.21 255 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action alongside a primary. Sign in, cancel, secondary nav.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: #ffffff; color: oklch(0.13 0.025 255); border: 1px solid oklch(0.91 0.01 255); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0.008 255); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.49 0.21 255); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.49 0.21 255 / 0.5); }

components.name: Vote Row
components.description: Primary list item in the organizer dashboard. Entire row is a link.
components.html:
Annual General Meeting
42 votesView →
components.css: .ds-vote-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 16px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid oklch(0.91 0.01 255); border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-vote-row:hover { border-color: oklch(0.49 0.21 255 / 0.3); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.06), 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.04); } .ds-vote-row__left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; } .ds-vote-row__dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; background: oklch(0.64 0.17 152); } .ds-vote-row__dot--active { background: oklch(0.64 0.17 152); } .ds-vote-row__dot--draft { background: oklch(0.71 0 0); } .ds-vote-row__dot--closed { background: oklch(0.71 0 0); } .ds-vote-row__title { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.13 0.025 255); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-vote-row__right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-left: 16px; } .ds-vote-row__count { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.55 0.02 255); } .ds-vote-row__action { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.55 0.02 255); transition: color 150ms; } .ds-vote-row:hover .ds-vote-row__action { color: oklch(0.49 0.21 255); }

components.name: Nav Item (Active)
components.description: Sidebar navigation item in active state. Uses Open Sky fill + Assembly Blue text.
components.html: My Votes
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.55 0.02 255); text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0.008 255); color: oklch(0.13 0.025 255); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: oklch(0.94 0.04 255); color: oklch(0.49 0.21 255); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Inline status label for vote state. Pill shape, muted fill.
components.html: Active Draft Closed
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-chip--active { background: oklch(0.93 0.07 152); color: oklch(0.38 0.13 152); } .ds-chip--draft { background: oklch(0.94 0.005 255); color: oklch(0.55 0.02 255); } .ds-chip--closed { background: oklch(0.94 0.005 255); color: oklch(0.55 0.02 255); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. Chalk Line border, white fill, Assembly Blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field__label { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.13 0.025 255); } .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid oklch(0.91 0.01 255); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: oklch(0.13 0.025 255); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.71 0.01 255); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.49 0.21 255); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.49 0.21 255 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview:
Votely is not a SaaS tool. It is the room where a community makes a decision. The people inside it already know each other: they're in the same church, the same school, the same organization. The interface carries the weight of that moment without making it feel heavy. Light, open, honest — the way a well-organized public meeting feels before it starts.

Color is restrained: Assembly Blue anchors trust and action; everything else is neutral so the ballot content, not the chrome, commands attention. Type is Inter at deliberately modest sizes. Depth is nearly flat. Surfaces are separated by fine chalk-line borders, not shadows.

This system explicitly rejects startup precision-noir and consumer-social theatrics. The Village Square is welcoming and purposeful, not cool or exciting.
keyCharacteristics: White page, blue intention: pure white canvas with Assembly Blue reserved for interactive elements only
Flat-first surfaces: borders define hierarchy; shadows signal state change, never decoration
Prose-sized type: Inter at readable weights — the ballot should feel like a printed form, not an app pitch
One tap, clear consequence: every action state is unambiguous at arm's length
Plain language throughout: status and error copy written as a neighbor would say it, not as a status code

rules.name: The Assembly Voice Rule
rules.body: Assembly Blue appears on interactive elements only and occupies less than 15% of any screen. Its rarity signals authority.

rules.name: The Tint Direction Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted toward blue (hue 255), not toward warm. No cream, sand, or parchment.

rules.name: The Flat-First Rule
rules.body: At rest, a surface has a Chalk Line border OR nothing. Shadow appears only on hover/active state. Never both border and shadow simultaneously.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Heading over body must have at least a 1-step weight jump. Two 400-weight elements at different sizes do not make hierarchy.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Minimum rendered body font size is 16px on voter-facing screens. Nothing below 12px in any active context.

dos: Do use Assembly Blue for interactive elements only. A blue headline or blue background section are both prohibited.
Do write every voter-facing error state as a person would say it. 'You're not at the venue' over 'Geo-validation failed.'
Do use the Chalk Line border as the primary separation tool. Reserve shadows for interactive lift states.
Do keep ballot tap targets a minimum of 64px tall on voter-facing screens.
Do use Inter's weight contrast (700+ over 400) to communicate hierarchy.
Do use text-wrap: balance on all h1–h3 elements.
donts: Don't use startup-generic aesthetics: no dark sidebar, no monospaced display type, no over-minimal chrome.
Don't use consumer-social polling patterns: no gradient hero numbers, no animated vote counters, no emoji reactions.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored side-stripe accent.
Don't use background-clip: text with any gradient.
Don't use border-radius above 16px on cards, vote rows, or inputs.
Don't use Assembly Blue and shadow-sm on the same element at rest.
Don't use cream, sand, beige, or warm-tinted neutral backgrounds.
Don't add uppercase tracked eyebrow labels above every section heading.
Don't use letter-spacing tighter than -0.04em on any text.
Don't gate voter-facing content visibility on animation class triggers.
